scope: Current working tree configuration and tracked file names/text; optional public TLS handshakes

findings.evidence: backend/src/main.ts: NestFactory.create(AppModule); HTTP listener. No repository evidence of a TLS termination proxy.
findings.remediation: Configure a trusted TLS 1.3 endpoint for HTTP and Socket.IO, reject plaintext externally, verify certificate chain, hostname, expiry and TLS 1.2 refusal.

findings.evidence: Redis client and TypeORM configuration inspected; explicit TLS options are absent in the current configuration.
findings.remediation: Enable verified TLS 1.3 for PostgreSQL and Redis; supply trusted CA material and test insecure connection refusal.

findings.evidence: Market WebSocket socket options inspected. wss alone does not enforce TLS 1.3.
findings.remediation: Set and test TLS 1.3 minimum on secure clients. Probe deployed destinations with certificate verification enabled.

findings.evidence: docker-compose.yml declares PostgreSQL and Redis named volumes and Redis AOF; no disk, volume or KMS encryption evidence is supplied.
findings.remediation: Provide deployment evidence of AES-256 or approved equivalent for volumes, snapshots and backups, including key ownership, access and rotation. AOF is not encryption.

findings.evidence: No private .env files appear in git ls-files (current index only).
findings.remediation: Keep credentials outside source control; rotate any exposed key and assess Git history separately.
